concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-quickstart-guide-onboarding-and-kyc]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms user-onboarding/KYC quickstart for hosted and API-only methods, conditional verification, Terms/PCI and support; guidance does not prove capability activation or payout.
warnings: Keep quickstart process guidance distinct from an account holder's verified status, granted capability, production readiness or paid-out funds.
